g.title: seq
g.text: 14a Budget cycle of a local government unit (province, city or municipality) under the Local Government Code

a.text: 1. Local chief executive to Local finance
committee: Annual investment program from the
approved local development plan
2. Local finance committee to Local chief
executive: Income estimate and recommended
spending ceiling by sector, based on the
approved local plans
3. Local chief executive to National agency:
Budget call with the ceilings
4. Local treasurer to Local chief executive:
Statements of income and expenditures
5. National agency to Local chief executive:
Budget proposals, on or before 15 July
6. Local chief executive to Local finance
committee: Review and budget hearings
7. Local chief executive to Sanggunian:
Executive budget, not later than 16 October
8. Sanggunian: Enact the appropriation
ordinance on or before the end of the current
fiscal year, within the legal limits (see 14b)
9. Sanggunian to Local chief executive:
Ordinance for approval
10. Sanggunian: Stay in session, with no other
business. After 90 days the ordinance of the
previous year is deemed reenacted, only for
salaries, statutory and contractual
obligations, and essential operating expenses
11. Sanggunian to Sanggunian: Copy of the
ordinance. DBM reviews provinces, highly
urbanized cities, independent component
cities, and municipalities in Metro Manila.
The provincial sanggunian reviews component
cities and municipalities

a.xlink:title: end of: No ordinance at the start of the fiscal year

a.text: 12. Sanggunian to Sanggunian: The ordinance is
deemed reviewed and stays in full force
13. Sanggunian to Sanggunian: Ordinance
declared inoperative in whole or in part. The
treasurer may not pay from those items
14. Local treasurer: Release allotments.
Collect local taxes and fees

a.xlink:title: end of: No action within 90 days
end of: Items exceed the legal limits

a.text: 15. BTr to Local treasurer: National Tax
Allotment released automatically and directly
to the treasurer (BTr)
16. Local treasurer: Before each payment:
budget officer certifies the appropriation,
accountant obligates it, treasurer certifies
available funds
17. National agency to Local chief executive:
Voucher certified and approved by the head of
the department. The local chief executive also
approves it, except for regularly recurring
administrative expenses (payrolls, utilities,
remittances)
18. Local treasurer to eSRE: Statement of
receipts and expenditures to BLGF (eSRE),
quarterly and annual. Accounts to COA
19. COA to Local chief executive: COA audit
report
